name: Movimiento Semilla: Ley de Contribución Extraordinaria ante la Crisis (May 2020)
detail: Semilla deputies' bill to make 'el 0.1% súper-rico' pay an extraordinary contribution during the Covid crisis; described as a higher income-tax rate on top earners (above Q5 million a year), not a tax on net wealth.

name: Leonel Lira (Encuentro por Guatemala) and Carlos Fión (CREO)
detail: Deputies reported in La Hora (Nov 2015) as willing to support Velásquez's temporary tax on large patrimonies; the article gives no words of theirs about a tax on wealth.

name: Abelardo Medina (ICEFI)
detail: Told Prensa Libre in Nov 2015 the justice system needs more resources and that a tax may be needed; no mention of wealth.

name: CACIF (Jorge Briz) and Cámara de Industria
detail: Business federation and industry chamber rejected Velásquez's 2015 proposal.

name: Bernardo Arévalo (Semilla government)
detail: Said in 2023 that his government would not raise taxes or create new ones, only curb evasion; no wealth tax in the plan reviewed.
